description: This source file defines an abstract class 'DocumentObjectCollection' which is a base class for collection classes within the PDFsharp Charting namespace. It manages a collection of 'DocumentObject' instances, providing methods for copying, cloning, insertion, removal, and enumeration. It also implements 'IList' interface members, though some are not fully implemented.

classes.name: DocumentObjectCollection
classes.description: An abstract class representing a collection of DocumentObject instances, with methods for manipulation, copying, and enumeration.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this collection.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Implements deep copying, including cloning contained DocumentObjects.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a DocumentObject to the collection, setting its parent.

methods.name: InsertObject
methods.description: Inserts a DocumentObject at the specified index.

methods.name: RemoveObjectAt
methods.description: Removes the DocumentObject at the specified index.
